name: apexlang-toolkit
description: An engineering framework for Oracle APEX apps written as APEXlang (.apx), on top of Oracle's official APEXlang skills: apexlang-architecture decides WHERE business logic, validation and DML belong (single write-path PL/SQL packages -- entity, multi-entity flow or external-system integration -- not region-bound Automatic DML); apex-sync-guard gates every apex import/export (Oracle's deploy script included) behind a Builder↔git divergence check against a recorded syncpoint, for one or several apps; apex-sentinel drives the running page in a browser, as a verified test user, before a change is called working; apex-ux judges a page's UI against criteria with IDs from WCAG 2.2 AA and Oracle's policies; apex-security states what the app must refuse, as criteria with IDs from Oracle's security policies and OWASP ASVS. apexlang-delivery runs them in order for one task and writes its verification-manifest. Fail-closed gates with JSON results (framework/).
